introHtml: Lincoln paper hand fans offer a classic, durable option for outdoor events, trade shows, and corporate giveaways. Made from sturdy kraft paper with a comfortable handle, these fans keep your audience cool while displaying your logo prominently. Choose from sizes like the 6" x 8 3/8" Toto or the larger 16" x 12" Judy to match your branding needs. Decorate with full-color printing for maximum visibility.
